title: Orange and ricotta pancakes with strawberries

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Every ingredient is a plain whole food or a basic staple: ricotta, eggs, milk, flour, fruit, honey and butter.

supermarket.reason: Oranges, strawberries, ricotta and self-raising flour are everyday Tesco items at normal prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a bowl, a whisk and a frying pan, and frying drop pancakes is well within a beginner's reach.

works.reason: 250g ricotta, 3 eggs, 150ml milk and 150g self-raising flour make a sensible thick batter for about 16 small pancakes, enough for four, and 2 minutes a side will cook them through.

honest_times.reason: Thirty minutes of active work covers the zesting, slicing and frying the batches, and the 35-minute total is realistic, even though frying is active work rather than unattended.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and the salt is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Orange runs through the batter, the juice dressing and the topping, which makes it central, and early May strawberries make it feel right for the date.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Ricotta and eggs give protein and there is plenty of fresh fruit, so it is a proper family breakfast with only a little honey.
